The [[Hosrel system/Legends|Hosrel system]] was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], situated on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Hosrel XI]].
